active.description:
If true, apply this rule to conversations. Otherwise, this rule is
inactive and saved as a draft.
active.rationale: This attribute controls the operational state of the rule and has no direct security impact.

analysis_percentage.description:
Percentage of conversations that we should apply this analysis setting
automatically, between [0, 1]. For example, 0.1 means 10%. Conversations
are sampled in a determenestic way. The original runtime_percentage &
upload percentage will be replaced by defining filters on the conversation.
analysis_percentage.rationale: Controls sampling percentage. No direct security impact.

conversation_filter.description:
Filter for the conversations that should apply this analysis
rule. An empty filter means this analysis rule applies to all
conversations.
Refer to https://cloud.google.com/contact-center/insights/docs/filtering
for details.
conversation_filter.rationale: A free-form expression selecting which conversations the analysis rule applies to. This is a team data-scoping choice, not a structural security control, and a generic platform policy cannot meaningfully constrain an arbitrary filter string without knowing team-specific data.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: Display Name of the analysis rule.
display_name.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Defines the project context only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.description: Selector of all available annotators and phrase matchers to run.

annotator_selector.issue_models.description:
The issue model to run. If not provided, the most recently deployed topic
model will be used. The provided issue model will only be used for
inference if the issue model is deployed and if run_issue_model_annotator
is set to true. If more than one issue model is provided, only the first
provided issue model will be used for inference.
annotator_selector.issue_models.rationale: Specifies issue model configuration only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.phrase_matchers.description:
The list of phrase matchers to run. If not provided, all active phrase
matchers will be used. If inactive phrase matchers are provided, they will
not be used. Phrase matchers will be run only if
run_phrase_matcher_annotator is set to true. Format:
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/phraseMatchers/{phrase_matcher}
annotator_selector.phrase_matchers.rationale: Specifies phrase matching configuration only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_entity_annotator.description: Whether to run the entity annotator.
annotator_selector.run_entity_annotator.rationale: Controls entity analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_intent_annotator.description: Whether to run the intent annotator.
annotator_selector.run_intent_annotator.rationale: Controls intent analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_interruption_anno.description: Whether to run the interruption annotator.
annotator_selector.run_interruption_anno.rationale: This controls whether sentiment analysis is performed. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_issue_model_annot.description:
Whether to run the issue model annotator. A model should have already been
deployed for this to take effect.
annotator_selector.run_issue_model_annot.rationale: Controls issue model analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_phrase_matcher_an.description: Whether to run the active phrase matcher annotator(s).
annotator_selector.run_phrase_matcher_an.rationale: Controls phrase matcher analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_qa_annotator.description: Whether to run the QA annotator.
annotator_selector.run_qa_annotator.rationale: Controls QA analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_sentiment_annotat.description: Whether to run the sentiment annotator.
annotator_selector.run_sentiment_annotat.rationale: Controls sentiment analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_silence_annotator.description: Whether to run the silence annotator.
annotator_selector.run_silence_annotator.rationale: Controls silence analysis behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.run_summarization_ann.description: Whether to run the summarization annotator.
annotator_selector.run_summarization_ann.rationale: Controls summarization behaviour only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.qa_config.scorecard_l.description: Container for a list of scorecards.

annotator_selector.qa_config.scorecard_l.rationale: Defines QaScorecardRevisions only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.summarization_config..rationale: Defines the conversation profile configuration only. No direct security impact.

annotator_selector.summarization_config..description:
Default summarization model to be used.
Possible values:
SUMMARIZATION_MODEL_UNSPECIFIED
BASELINE_MODEL
BASELINE_MODEL_V2_0 Possible values: ["BASELINE_MODEL", "BASELINE_MODEL_V2_0"]
annotator_selector.summarization_config..rationale: Defines the summarization model only. No direct security impact.
